protocol.source: Batch A grouped retrieval metadata + informative mask
protocol.answer_dedup: exact duplicate text removed within a group
protocol.informative_filter: batch A informative mask + answer length >= 25

limitations: Rule-fire rate, not an error rate: no human adjudicated these groups.
Groups can legitimately contain answers for different crops/stages, so some flags are context differences.
Only the train+val side of the grouped split is scanned; test rows are not included.
At most five answers per group and at most 200 review rows are kept.
